description: The most stable form of the ascended Sliver known as Kranus, who was originally a mechanical husk housing the madness distilled from Draegar's tortured mind. Owing to the inherent chaos of the Void and the catastrophic end of Prime Athensphere, it was initially erratic, shifting between blinding light and interminable darkness; no doubt this was drawn from the demigods' own beliefs of their creators. However, after an arduous journey forced by circumstance, the Sliver seems to have chosen its light-form permanently.For every world on the Prime, its divergent twin exists beyond the Veil—an invisible, cosmic curtain that separates the two timelines. While Prime Athensphere met its untimely end when Gazia attempted to seize the power of the Void for himself, its Echo remained intact, though it was not without its troubles—a trait common to all worlds, Echo or no. After observing Azius's attempts to make contact across the vast space, Kranus took matters into its own hands and waited for an opportune moment to spirit the Summoner away. All told, it was a miracle the Summoner arrived safely, though they would later be returned to Grand Gaia by an unexpected third party.Later, Noel proposed an initiative to observe the Echoes from a safe distance in the Summoner's Hall, and it was clear that the Sliver had made forays of its own elsewhere. Delving deeper into Kranus's mysterious goals, the Summoner's fate became entangled with the Void and its nemesis, the Queen in Cobalt.No one but the Summoner would know what became of this cosmic rivalry; indeed, some wonder if anything happened at all, or if they had simply failed to remember...
summon:
She is out there somewhere.
Waiting. Watching.
...But aren't we all?
fusion:
The more I come to know you,
the less sense it makes.
evolution: Tell me. What is it like to be you?
